page.title: Alabama Termite Map
page.intro: Documented Alabama termite records from museum vouchers, published county records, and an optional static iNaturalist snapshot.

legend.inaturalist_heading: iNaturalist Research Grade (300 m map circles)

sources.title: Sources & references
sources.museum_text: Auburn University Natural History Museum / Alabama Termite Identification Service. Public specimen coordinates are privacy-generalized by up to 300 m and are shown only as location-uncertainty areas.
sources.inaturalist_text: Static snapshot dated {snapshot_date}. Records are licensed Research Grade/community-assessed observations and are not independently verified by the Alabama Termite Identification Service. For visual comparability with museum circles, each iNaturalist observation is displayed as a 300 m-radius map circle. This circle does not indicate privacy generalization or coordinate uncertainty.
sources.boundaries_text: Local Alabama county snapshot from U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb. Basemap tiles are from OpenStreetMap.
